correctness.rationale: The duad–syntheme incidence construction gives the specified simple cubic bipartite graph. Two disjoint duads share a unique syntheme, precluding a 4-cycle; three pairwise disjoint duads exhaust the base set and force the same syntheme, precluding a 6-cycle. The independent replay exhausts the perfect matchings by branching on the least uncovered vertex. It builds transitions both by enumerating all simple 8-cycles and by testing every matching pair for a connected eight-edge difference. The edge sets agree: 90 cycles, 32 alternating matching endpoints per cycle, 288 matchings and 1440 flip edges, all vertices of degree 10. Complement traversal gives exactly 144 of each stated type and every edge crosses the two types. All-source BFS covers all 288 vertices and yields (1,10,42,97,101,37,0) for type (30) and (1,10,45,97,96,37,2) for type (10,20), proving the radius, diameter and center. Exact comparison with the frozen JSON certificate agrees for the incidence edges, cycles, states, types, transitions and all distance histograms.
residual_risks: This is exhaustive computation on the specified finite graph, not formal verification or a theorem for other move lengths or graphs.
